proof_body:
by
  intro z n hz
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih
    have h := Complex.arg_mul_coe_angle (pow_ne_zero n hz) hz
    rw [← Real.Angle.coe_add, Real.Angle.angle_eq_iff_two_pi_dvd_sub, ← pow_succ] at h
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := h
    refine ⟨k + l, ?_⟩
    push_cast
    rw [hk] at hl
    linarith
target_source: ∀ (z : ℂ) (n : ℕ), z ≠ 0 → ∃ k : ℤ, Complex.arg (z ^ n) = n * Complex.arg z + 2 * k * Real.pi
